:::{.phase-header}
# R Workbook

**A hands-on guide to R for content analysis research**

Seven chapters take you from building a codebook to publishing a professional White Paper.
:::

---

## What You'll Learn

This workbook is your companion for the R programming portion of the course (Phases III to V). Each chapter builds on the previous one, following the same dataset through the full research pipeline: the Twitch corpus that ships inside the course `v2v` package, 35,267 chat messages and 32,276 stream snapshots drawn from fifty channels between November 18 and 24, 2018.

| Chapter | Title | What You'll Do |
|---------|-------|---------------|
| 1 | [Codebook](01-codebook.qmd) | Turn qualitative observations into numeric codes |
| 2 | [Data Collection](02-data-collection.qmd) | Code your full sample with consistency checks |
| 3 | [Meet R](03-meet-r.qmd) | Set up R and your VS Code workspace |
| 4 | [Data Wrangling](04-data-wrangling.qmd) | Import, clean, and export your dataset |
| 5 | [Describing Data](05-describing-data.qmd) | Build frequency tables and publication-ready charts |
| 6 | [Inferencing Data](06-inferencing-data.qmd) | Run and interpret the course's statistical tests |
| 7 | [Publishing](07-publishing.qmd) | Assemble your White Paper as a Quarto Book |

---

## How to Use This Workbook

1. **Read the chapter**, then follow along in VS Code; the code blocks are designed to run in order
2. **Use the class dataset** for practice: `library(v2v)`, then `twitch_chat()` and `twitch_streams()`, with no file to download
3. **Apply to your own data** for the White Paper
